info.title: AgentHU API
info.description:
Backend, data platform and Agent foundations for the AgentHU Personal AI.

All external sources are normalized into a unified **Event** contract before any
domain logic runs. The Backend is the single source of truth for identity,
permissions, events, tasks, goals, current state, memory, plans and files.

This is the **M0** API surface: engineering baseline plus frozen core contracts.

post.description: OAuth2 password grant form, used by the OpenAPI 'Authorize' button.

``client_event_id`` values so the client can clear its pending queue.

post.description: Confirm a memory (also the documented "un-reject" path).
Replace a memory with a corrected version (201: a new row is created).
Reject a memory; the live row stays as a REJECTED subject_key placeholder.

get.description:
Return the client's "today" plan.

The confirmed plan is returned when present; otherwise a deterministic
baseline plan is generated (pending confirmation) so the client always has
something to display and confirm. Selection and per-user/day idempotency
live in ``planner.resolve_today_plan`` (DECISIONS.md D-019).

CurrentStateUpdate.title: CurrentStateUpdate
CurrentStateUpdate.description: User-controlled overrides applied before the next projection.

DocumentEvidence.title: DocumentEvidence
DocumentEvidence.description: A citation pinned to an exact document version (M3 grounding tuple).

EventEvidence.title: EventEvidence
EventEvidence.description: A citation of a stored Event by id.

MemoryCorrectRequest.title: MemoryCorrectRequest
MemoryCorrectRequest.description:
User correction payload for POST /memory/{id}/correct.

Content is the corrected text; confidence optionally overrides (the old
row's value carries over when absent). The new version is CONFIRMED by
definition — the user wrote it.

MemoryEvidence.title: MemoryEvidence
MemoryEvidence.description: A citation of another memory row (e.g. L2 facts citing their L1 base).

PlanGenerateRequest.title: PlanGenerateRequest
PlanGenerateRequest.description: Deterministic baseline planner input (no LLM in M0).
